x: 2000mW; 1.G.Porter 11.20.8,(CBP), 2.J.McGroder 12.22.8, 3.R.Parrott 13.03.1, 4.A.Coore 13.39.3, 5.D.Cameron 13.43.5, Also walked at the meeting; Tracey Johnson(Disq), R.Honeychurch 12.41.5, David McGroder 12.41.5, Charva Daure 15.35.9. 8½ year old Sarah O'Connell completed 800m in 7.33.
Injuries affected Gail Porter, Joanne McGroder and Mary Anna O'Connell and 'flu', mumps and various other illnesses hit everybody at some stage during the season.

Good performances in the Girls race from Rachael Parrott (with a personal best) and a 3rd place team medal. Good walking in the Juniors from an injured Gail Porter and Joanne McGroder and good backing for 4th team.

Our walkers were well represented in the English Schools Walking Championships with London being represented by Gail Porter, Kim Marsh, Isobel Young and Charlotte Chirstou and Surrey and Essex being represented by Rachael Parrott and Joanne McGroder respectively.
